::: {.v-top}
### Transparency + Evidence-based Practices + Teacher Support<br><br>Better Outcomes for All.
<br>
This website provides free, printable visualizations of public data on district operations and student literacy outcomes in New York public schools.

Our goal is to help parents, teachers, and community members use data and work together to advocate for evidence-based practices and effective teacher support so that all student outcomes improve.

FAPE is not optional. Every student deserves the opportunity to learn to read and write. Teachers deserve a supportive and safe workplace, too.

If you share our commitment to improving equity and student outcomes rather than profiting at their expense, we welcome your ideas, feedback, and contributions.
:::
